title: Welcome to Qamaria

blocks.t: Brand story and vision briefing
Version 1.0 (draft) | Nov 17, 2026
Draft for Qamaria sign-off. Part of QUS-SOP-01 Brand story and vision.

notes: Group: Welcome everyone as they sit. Say your name and role. Say this is the start of induction day. One to one: Sit beside the new starter, not across a desk. Same welcome. Both: Point to the version and date. Say this is the deck everyone is briefed from. If anyone holds a different version, ask them to tell the Site Manager. Allow about 20 minutes in all (assumed). Step 1 and 2.

title: Before we start

t: You will read the Qamaria story, one slide at a time.
Then you will say it back in your own words.
Your briefer will record it on the briefing log.
Check the version and date on the first slide. Tell the Site Manager if it is not the latest one.

notes: Group: Say the four points in order. Ask if anyone has seen the Qamaria story before. Do not ask anyone to read aloud. One to one: Ask what they already know about Qamaria. Listen first. Both: Say that nobody is being tested. The aim is that everyone can say why Qamaria exists. Step 1 and 2.

title: Our story

blocks.t: "I'm in love with Yemeni coffee and on a mission to share it with the world."
The co-founder
Qamaria Brand Guide, Our Story

notes: Group: Read the quote once, slowly. Pause. Ask: what does "on a mission" mean to you? Take one or two answers. One to one: Read it, then ask the same question. Both: Do not add facts about the founder, farmers, sourcing or impact. Say only what the slide says. Step 3.

title: Our mission

blocks.t: "Share the authentic heritage, culture, and craftsmanship of Yemeni coffee with the world."
Qamaria Brand Guide

notes: Group: Read it once. Ask each person to pick the one word that stands out. Go round the room. One to one: Ask for one word. Both: Point out that the mission is about sharing. It is not only about selling coffee. Say only what the slide says. Step 4.

title: Our vision

blocks.t: "To build a globally recognized coffee brand rooted in authenticity, quality, hospitality, and tradition."
Qamaria Brand Guide

notes: Group: Read the vision. Ask: which of the four words (authenticity, quality, hospitality, tradition) will you see in your job first? One to one: Same question. Both: Link the word they choose to something they will do on shift. Do not promise anything about the site's future. Step 5.

title: Our goal

blocks.t: "To become the world's most recognized Yemeni coffee brand while preserving the heritage and hospitality that make Qamaria unique."
One Vision. One Family. One Qamaria.
Qamaria Brand Guide, Our Goal

notes: Group: Read the goal, then the closing line together if the group is comfortable. One to one: Read both lines yourself. Both: Say that every site is part of one brand. This is why we follow the same standards. Step 5.

title: Our three promises to customers

t: 1. The authentic taste and heritage of Yemeni coffee.
3. The same Qamaria experience in every café.

blocks.t: These promises are second-hand. Qamaria to confirm.

notes: Group: Read the three promises. Ask the group which one they think is hardest to keep on a busy shift. One to one: Ask the same. Both: Say the wording is awaiting Qamaria's confirmation. Do not present it as final. Step 6 (proposal P8).

title: Who Qamaria serves

blocks.t: The customers and communities of every Qamaria café, in the US and in the other countries Qamaria serves.
They return because the visit feels welcoming and familiar.
Second-hand wording. Qamaria to confirm.

notes: Group: Read it. Ask: who is the next customer you will serve? What would make that visit feel welcoming and familiar? One to one: Same question. Both: Say the wording is awaiting Qamaria's confirmation. Step 7 (proposal P8).

tag: D. LINK THE STORY TO THE WORK
title: From promise to procedure

rows: 1. The authentic taste and heritage of Yemeni coffee
3. The same Qamaria experience in every café
Opening and closing (5.1), cleaning (5.6) and QUS-SOP-04 Brand standards overview

blocks.t: If a promise has no procedure, tell the Site Manager.
These sections are planned in the draft framework. Qamaria to confirm.

notes: Group: Walk down the table. For each promise, ask who in the room will deliver it. One to one: Ask the starter which procedure they expect to use first. Both: These manual sections are planned, not all written. If a promise has no procedure behind it, the starter tells the Site Manager. Do not make one up. Step 8 (proposal P9).

tag: D. LINK THE STORY TO THE WORK
title: Now tell it back

blocks.t: Use two or three sentences. In your own words. Do not read from the slides.

notes: Group: Give two minutes. Ask each person to tell it to a partner, then ask two or three to tell the room. One to one: Ask the starter to tell it to you. Both: Listen for three things: why Qamaria exists, what it promises, who it serves. If they cannot yet, go back through slides 3 to 9. Do not sign the log until they can. After this the briefer fills in the briefing log (SOP step 10). That is not part of the deck.
